description: Kanban boards, sprints, tickets and a team wiki, with versioned writes for concurrent agents.
name: io.github.Developyn/laver-mcp

environmentVariables.description: A workspace-scoped API key, created in Laver under Admin → API keys. It acts as the person who created it, so it holds exactly their access and can be revoked without touching their account. Supply this or LAVER_API_KEY_FILE.
environmentVariables.name: LAVER_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Alternative to LAVER_API_KEY: a path to a file holding nothing but the key, or a .env-style file carrying a LAVER_API_KEY= line. Use this to keep the key out of your client's config file.
environmentVariables.name: LAVER_API_KEY_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Overrides the API host. Defaults to https://api.laver.app, and must be https except for localhost.
environmentVariables.name: LAVER_API_URL
